subject: Upcoming Team Building Event
body: Hello team, I hope this email finds you well. We are excited to announce that our annual team building event is coming up next month. It will be a fun-filled day with various team-building activities, games, and a BBQ lunch. Please mark your calendars for [date] and stay tuned for more details. We look forward to strengthening our team spirit and having a great time together. See you all there!
